# BelmontUI

> BelmontUI is a BepInEx 6 IL2CPP library for Castlevania: Belmont's Curse mods. It adds a MODS tab to the game's pause menu and title-screen Settings, listing each registered mod with a sub-menu built from the game's own widgets. Mods soft-depend on it (GUID `leandrobueno.belmontui`, namespace `BelmontUi`) and register settings once in `Load()` with `BelmontUi.Settings.Register(guid, title, menu => ...)` or `Settings.RegisterFromConfig(guid, title, Config)`. Every `BelmontUi.*` reference must live in a class entered only after `IL2CPPChainloader.Instance.Plugins.ContainsKey("leandrobueno.belmontui")`, or the mod throws FileNotFoundException without the library. Rows: Toggle, Slider, IntSlider, Choice, Key, Button, ResetButton, Binding (press a gamepad button, key or held+pressed combination; shown with the game's Xbox/PlayStation icons; BindingOptions for devices, allowed/reserved controls and a Validate reason), Header (section title) and VisibleWhen(Func<bool>) on the last row. ControlBinding parses and reads stored bindings (Input System control names, "held+pressed", "" unbound). Every row's hint is shown next to its label, up to two lines. LocalizedText gives any text per language; the tab follows the game's eleven languages. MIT licensed. Current version 0.4.0.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://leandrobueno.github.io/BelmontUI/getting-started): install, requirements, csproj reference, the soft-dependency pattern with a full glue-class example
- [API reference](https://leandrobueno.github.io/BelmontUI/api): Settings, SettingsMenu, every builder method (Toggle, Slider, IntSlider, Choice, Key, Button, ResetButton, Binding, Header, VisibleWhen), BindingOptions, ControlBinding, descriptions, RegisterFromConfig rules, validation errors, translations (LocalizedText), when values save
- [Recipes](https://leandrobueno.github.io/BelmontUI/recipes): three-setting mod, Config.Bind-only menu, key setting, gamepad button picked by pressing it, combination with a Validate check, section headers and conditional rows, hints that fit, reset button, action button, run-time replacement
- [How it works](https://leandrobueno.github.io/BelmontUI/how-it-works): tab placement, Belmont Minimap coexistence, native widget cloning, binding capture and controller icons, two-line descriptions and taller rows, rows reacting to other settings, saving, failure on game updates
- [Troubleshooting](https://leandrobueno.github.io/BelmontUI/troubleshooting): log lines, "no tab" checklist, binding rows (Steam Input icons, timeout, keys that cancel), compatibility

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/leandrobueno/BelmontUI/blob/master/AGENTS.md): everything needed to add BelmontUI support to a mod without reading the source
